rows.name: prerequisites-clean-artifacts
rows.conclusion: Ten fresh prerequisites, clean selected optimized host build and clean retained/cache ELF link. Every native/measurement worker uses the exact signed host hash.

rows.name: comparison-selection
rows.conclusion: All eight preserved comparison axes reviewed; 32 selected packages, existing chosen terms/notices and frozen Slint inputs unchanged. Historical candidate failures and P2-09 source pins remain historical; final source is rebuilt separately. Actual release clearance remains false.

rows.name: renderer-fixtures
rows.conclusion: Unchanged locked 30-configuration/150-capture renderer corpus, workflow and integrated text fixtures pass. Independent pixel/edge consumers pass without tolerance changes.

rows.name: keyboard-pointer
rows.conclusion: Selected keyboard/pointer, focus, capture, modal dismissal, transforms, queue/reset and semantic-action parity pass.

rows.name: text
rows.conclusion: Two byte-identical final text runs pass 45 observations, six composition cases and fourteen negatives; separate pinned native HarfBuzz verification passes. Full Unicode/native IME remains outside this subset.

rows.name: semantics-readability
rows.conclusion: Independent semantic/geometry/edge assertions, virtual list navigation, high contrast, reduced motion and scale behavior pass. No native assistive consumer is claimed.

rows.name: typed-actions-context
rows.conclusion: Four entry adapters use one typed executor; 56 modeled context/action negatives and independent checkpoint decoding pass. Hosted rights remain a model, not enforced guest capabilities.

rows.name: token-reload
rows.conclusion: Native generation 7-to-8 publication visibly changes tokens in the same worker/window with complete unsaved state and geometry preserved; continued editing passes.

rows.name: layout-reload
rows.conclusion: Supported structural layout publication reconciles stable IDs. Removed focus, active capture/gesture, composition and queued-input policies pass.

rows.name: failed-update
rows.conclusion: Invalid, stale, missing, oversize, build, validation, opacity and staging failures preserve the old editable generation. Original development failures remain local.

rows.name: reader-retirement
rows.conclusion: In-use readers retain immutable resources; delayed release, queue bounds and fourth-root headroom refusal/retry have bounded outcomes.

rows.name: repeated-reload
rows.conclusion: 100 measured file publications after five warm-up cycles at each resolution preserve complete checkpoints. No retired roots remain and the independently normalized Rust-live plateau and fixed process/cache tolerances pass.

rows.name: damage-idle
rows.conclusion: 108 exact incremental/full images and 300 layout-cache probes pass. Static/hidden/minimized native phases submit zero frames; caret/clock/observer costs are measured separately.

rows.name: metrics
rows.conclusion: 3000 frame and 8444 process samples across five paired optimized repetitions. 2962/3000 frames exceed 16.667 ms elapsed budget. Raw p50/p95/p99, phase/input/submission, idle, growth/peaks and file visibility remain recorded; these do not pass guest targets.

rows.name: harness-cleanup
rows.conclusion: Seven stale/build/profile/missing/skipped/unreaped/missing-result mutations reject. Real early-exit/timeout processes reject and reap; the exact final executable separately exercises normal/nonzero/timeout child lifecycles.

rows.name: documentation-regressions
rows.conclusion: Fresh Phase 0, final documentation/governance/schema checks pass. Post-promotion index hygiene is separately recorded. No kernel, M1 build/package/launch or pinned tool/dependency input changed, so no new M1 boot regression was required or claimed.
